description: Start applying to a vacancy automatically on the person's behalf. freehire tailors their CV to the vacancy, checks the employer's application form against their saved answers, and waits for a review (auto_apply_review) before submitting. Spends one of today's auto-apply allowance, so it needs a paid plan, and the account's switch letting agents apply. Only vacancies on supported applicant-tracking systems can be started. Follow progress with auto_apply_get.

job_slug.description: The vacancy's slug, as search_jobs and my_jobs return it.

name: auto_apply_start
title: Start an automatic application
